[NSBK.6.1] The seven backings, each named by the body message of its atom in
[RDSC.7.1], and the algorithm each runs:

| Atom | Backs |
|---|---|
| `SeriesBackendWelfordEwma` | Welford running stats (cumulative) — mean / stdev / variance accumulators |
| `SeriesBackendRingBuffer` | ring buffer — windowed exact values |
| `SeriesBackendMonotonicDeque` | monotonic deque — exact sliding min/max |
| `SeriesBackendFifoDeque` | FIFO deque — first / bool sliding |
| `SeriesBackendReservoir` | reservoir sampling — k-sample from an unbounded stream |
| `SeriesBackendIntervalPulse` | interval-pulse deque — `active_fraction` ([LSIG.2.2]) |
| `SeriesBackendNumericIntegral` | numeric integral — `integral` ([LSIG.2.3]) |

All seven are built into `libds.a` and registered at engine construction
([NSBK.2]).
